# Bundled canvas dependency

Konva 10.7.1, MIT license (see `KONVA-LICENSE.txt`). Downloaded from the published npm package at `https://unpkg.com/konva@10.7.1/konva.min.js`.

The Editor loads this local copy; no CDN or npm runtime is required on the user's computer. The application owns its editable project model; Konva manages only canvas interactions and drawing.

Upstream documentation: https://konvajs.org/docs/
